Tatlow, A.H;

South African Railways. Publicity Dept
commons.description:
The Ndwandwe county of Natal Province (now KwaZulu-Natal), South Africa (in pink and outlined in red). Currently the adjacent areas in Mozambique and Eswatini (both in green) are respectively the Matutuíne District of Maputo Province, the Lubuli division of Lubombo Region and the Somntongo division of Shiselweni Region. The undulations of the Lebombo Range are shown with a number of streams issuing from its valleys, besides the Usutu, Ingwavuma and Pongola Rivers which traverse it from west to east.
